query.sql: SELECT "$producer" AS node_id, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.node_role') AS node_role, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.total_stored_messages') AS INTEGER) AS total_messages, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.health_score') AS INTEGER) AS health_score, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.irregularity_count') AS INTEGER) AS anomalies, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.status_summary') AS status_summary, "$when" AS audited_at FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'MessageStateAudit' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT "$when" AS detected_at, "$producer" AS reporting_node, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.health_score') AS INTEGER) AS health_score, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.irregularity_count') AS INTEGER) AS anomaly_count, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.status_summary') AS triage_notes FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'MessageStateAudit' AND CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.irregularity_count') AS INTEGER) > 0 ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 50
